item.title: [ABC Action News / Tampa Bay 28] Armed man arrested at Trump’s California golf course ahead of president’s visit
item.description: An armed man was arrested outside Trump National Golf Club in California before Trump's visit. Investigators say the suspect had weapons, body armor and notebooks with "concerning statements."
